title: ToolTest 14 - Sketch Fillet, Trim and Offset

courses.title: ToolTest 14 - Sketch Fillet, Trim and Offset
courses.objective: Use the live sketch editing tools on connected geometry and validate corner creation, trimming and connected-chain offset behavior.

steps.title: Create connected sketch geometry
steps.instructions: Draw intersecting lines plus a connected line/arc chain.
steps.expectedResult: Editable sketch geometry suitable for all three tools.

checkpoint.expected: Editable sketch geometry suitable for all three tools.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Sketch fillet
steps.instructions: Set a radius and select two meeting lines or their corner.
steps.expectedResult: The sharp corner is replaced by a tangent fillet arc.

checkpoint.expected: The sharp corner is replaced by a tangent fillet arc.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Trim
steps.instructions: Click the unwanted segment between intersections.
steps.expectedResult: The clicked portion is removed while intended remaining entities stay.

checkpoint.expected: The clicked portion is removed while intended remaining entities stay.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Offset connected chain
steps.instructions: Set offset distance and click a curve on the desired side.
steps.expectedResult: The whole connected loop or chain is offset to the chosen side.

checkpoint.expected: The whole connected loop or chain is offset to the chosen side.

validationChecks: No offset failure for the chosen radius/distance
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Edit inputs and inspect stability
steps.instructions: Repeat with another valid radius and offset distance.
steps.expectedResult: Sketch operations remain usable with changed values.

checkpoint.expected: Sketch operations remain usable with changed values.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.
